name: Wall of Ash
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You create a wall of hot ash within long range that is 15 ft high, 5 ft thick, and up to 30 ft long or a circular wall with a diameter of short range. Uncheck any number of Conditions and roll Spirit to set the Difficulty.

Each creature that enters the wall, is within the wall when it's created or begins its turn within the wall must roll Fortitude against the Difficulty. On a failure, the creature takes 1d4 damage, and for the next round, it is blinded and cannot breathe. When the round ends, repeat the roll. On a pass, it takes half damage. No further effects and no repeated roll.

For each Condition you unchecked (twice for Afraid and Angry), choose one:

  • The wall becomes 10 ft longer or taller, or the diameter increases by 10 ft.

  • +1d damage.

  • Whenever you maintain concentration for this spell, you may move the wall or part of the wall an additional 5 ft in any direction you choose.

Describe how you create the wall.
successes:
✨: On each failure, the blinded effect persists for 1 minute, regardless of subsequent rolls against the Difficulty.

🌞: On each failure, the cannot breathe for 1 minute, regardless of subsequent rolls against the Difficulty.
